summary: Verdict: PASS (design-level). 280-sat/14-plane population-proxy scene, 16,988-endpoint coverage ledger (occurrence-verified, zero never_visible), byte-identical load10 duplicate pair (same trace_seed/config/controlled_signature/trace_identity hashes), machine-enforced pairing and non-learning contracts, layered classifier that strictly separates ACCESS/ROUTE/DOWNLINK failure from ISL pressure, and claim boundaries excluding real traffic/global service/RL value are all coherent and fail-closed. No Pro-tier routing used (routing.policy=hop, learning_enabled=false, algorithm=none). Package is at COMPILED_REVIEW_REQUIRED with execution_authorized=false everywhere; no VM results exist or are claimed. Safe to proceed to finalization; authorization remains gated on accepted finalization plus cold_start and adversarial reviews. Two minor findings: all-zero acceptance thresholds (mitigated by scene_check layers) and coverage-audit window (3600s) vs run window (30s) mismatch that must not be misread as in-window coverage.

findings.summary: Pair/seed identity is machine-verified: both load10 cells share trace_seed=7, pairing_key=load10-s7, identical config_sha256, controlled_signature and trace_identity_sha256; resolved configs are byte-identical.

Non-learning separation is enforced at compile time: non_learning phase requires algorithm=none, no learning seed, not_applicable lineage; no Pro-tier/learning routing anywhere (policy=hop, contract C3, learning_enabled=false).

Claim boundaries correctly exclude real subscriber traffic, universal global service, algorithm superiority, RL value, and premature first-pressure-point claims; provenance=population_proxy is a hard-checked contract field.

Layered classifier cleanly separates access/route/downlink failure from ISL pressure: closed status order, closed offered/admitted denominators, zero-admitted short-circuit to ACCESS_LIMITED, and L6 requiring >=2 consecutive same-directed-link 1s windows at >=0.8 utilization plus positive p95 queue delay, with missing denominators and window gaps unable to fabricate candidacy.

Coverage ledger holds exactly 16,988 endpoint entries (occurrence count) matching candidate_regions=16988, with zero never_visible:true rows, satisfying require_never_visible=0; L1 recomputes source SHA, aggregation, count, window and ledger length and fails closed.

Cell acceptance thresholds are all zero (min_delivered_packets=0, require_data_isl=false, require_control_delivery=false): a degenerate run can still earn a natural-end verified receipt. Mitigated because scene_check layers classify such runs as ACCESS_LIMITED/NO_ISL_EXPOSURE rather than pressure, but the intent (acceptance deliberately weak, decision power in scene_check) should be stated in RUNBOOK/brief to prevent misreading.

Coverage audit window (horizon 3600s, step 60s) differs from the 30s run/observation window; the ledger proves hourly geometric visibility, not in-window visibility. In-window invisibility is caught as access/route failure by L3/L4, but reports must not cite the coverage ledger as in-window coverage.

Scene decision, coverage audit and scene-check contract are hash-bound into the compile artifact map and re-verified at analysis time; tamper fails before authorization, satisfying brief acceptance #3. Compile state is COMPILED_REVIEW_REQUIRED with execution_authorized=false and no launcher generated; no VM run exists or is claimed.
